title.narrative: New policies and programmes in the field of job retention, employment-rich investment and active labour market policies designed and applied as a contribution to economically and socially sustainable crisis recovery in Ukraine

description.narrative: The ILO will support Ukraine in addressing labour-market imbalances, including acute labour shortages in key sectors, by strengthening the capacity of the State Employment Service to design and deliver targeted, integrated employment services, as well as more effective active labour market policies. The intervention will promote job retention and employment-rich recovery, including tailored activation pathways for groups facing persistent barriers to labour-market integration. Through locally driven models such as Local Employment Partnerships, the ILO will also advance cross-cutting and decentralised approaches that catalyse job creation at the community level, combining training, entrepreneurship support, access to finance, transition-to-formality measures and outreach to vulnerable groups. By reinforcing national and local employment systems and promoting coordinated labour-market interventions, the support will contribute to a more inclusive, productive and sustainable recovery.
